description.zh: 搜索关键词，支持任务 ID（数字或 task_ 前缀）或创建人名称模糊匹配
description.en: A search keyword for fuzzy matching on the task ID or creator's name. A task ID can be a number or a string prefixed with `task_`.

description.zh: 每页返回条数，默认20，最大100
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

description.zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
description.en: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending). Default: `desc`.
The task status to filter by.

title.zh: 获取资产盘点任务列表

descriptions.zh: 对应控制台 /knowledge/job/inventory/list，分页查询当前租户下的资产盘点任务历史，支持按任务 ID、创建人关键词及状态筛选
descriptions.en: This operation maps to the `/knowledge/job/inventory/list` page in the console. It retrieves a paginated list of asset inventory jobs for the current tenant. You can filter the jobs by task ID, creator name keywords, or task status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-inventory-jobs --query task_1001 --status 1 --size 20 --offset 0 --sort-by confidence --sort-order desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListInventoryJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --Query task_1001 --Size 20 --SortBy confidence --SortOrder desc --Offset 0
